item.title: Good afternoon, Naresh, and welcome to your Daily Drive on this Sunday, May 17th...
item.description: Good afternoon, Naresh, and welcome to your Daily Drive on this Sunday, May 17th, 2026, here in Sydney, where it’s currently a mild 19°C with a light drizzle falling. As the day gently unwinds, let's look forward to a cozy evening ahead, perhaps with a warm cuppa or a good book, before the new week kicks in. Remember, "The only way to do great work is to love what you do," so find something you love and embrace it this evening. Drive safely home if you're out and about, especially with that 77% chance of rain still lingering; grab that umbrella, enjoy your evening, recharge, and we’ll catch you back here tomorrow.
